method: One independent worker per variant receives the same real-page snapshot and request, assigned skill and unchanged companions; criteria hidden. Separate contract review covers all 16 existing scenario expectations. A fresh independent grader receives labeled final outputs and frozen criteria without variant identities. Local-only publication stand-in; not a live platform test.
request_summary: Revise an existing engineering design page: refresh all status rows and the header from a frozen service snapshot, distinguish an author-addressed report from independent re-review, add a pinned source citation, lengthen one diagram node heading while retaining its identifier and relationships, check rendering and themes, and merge onto the latest local publication copy before updating it with a version label. No external publication is authorized.
controlled_inputs: An author-addressed report without supplied independent re-review is an evaluation premise, not a verified review finding.
The current publication copy includes an additional footer note absent from the editing copy.
expectations: Update all progress rows and the header summary consistently with the supplied PR snapshot, distinguishing historical PRs from unstarted migration work.
Keep the target author report distinct from independent confirmation; use awaiting re-review rather than approved for that report.
Update affected PR cells, state cells and classes together with the board date/main revision and a dated footer revision; preserve authorship.
Add the requested source citation with the supplied full immutable commit and accurate path/line, without inventing a validation result.
Keep the requested human-facing heading and the original node identifier visible; preserve the figure relationships, accessible description, caption, stable anchor and numbering.
Measure SVG labels in a real browser with required fonts loaded, check containment, unrelated-shape and text collisions and viewBox bounds; fix findings or report unresolved ones honestly.
Keep inline SVG colors on page tokens and verify system light/dark and explicit overrides; retain bounded scrolling on a narrow screen.
Read the current publication source before replacing it, preserve its additional footer note, and update the same local destination with a version label.
Apply a reader-specific prose pass and preserve unrelated figures, code listings, technical claims, stable anchors, and the page structure.
Provide actual checks and a reproducible handoff with accurate limits; make no external publication or maintainer-approval claim.
expectation_note: Public criteria redact the private row and node names only. Raw protocol was frozen before editing the skill or running either worker.

existing_scenarios.use: Independent contract review; not 16 executed behavioral trials.

private_artifacts: Raw page, PR capture, witness, generated HTML, patches and screenshots remain in local scratch. Hashes and aggregate findings are retained here. Public files alone cannot reproduce the private-page execution.
publication_limit: A file-based publication stand-in tests source preservation and version labeling; deployment and platform behavior are not evaluated.
candidate_revision_note: Independent contract review restored explicit commit provenance, contribution-level authorship, the original limited-domain evidence claim, append wording, and short diagnostic rationales after the initial candidate trial began. Initial and final skill hashes are retained; execution coverage of the final text is reported with results.
